apiKeys.heading: Provider API keys
apiKeys.description: Register API keys from your data providers. These keys will be made usable for all members of your organization, to access imagery that requires an API key. API Keys are saved encrypted and are never exposed to users in their requests. Keys are tied to a host-adress to prevent campaign users trying to pass it anywhere else,
apiKeys.noTileHost: No tile host - not usable yet
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.tileHostHelp: The tile host is the provider address this key belongs to - <host>{{host}}</host> for Planet basemaps and scenes, the host in your provider's tile URL otherwise (its subdomains count too). The server sends this key there and refuses everywhere else, so a campaign pointing its imagery at some other address cannot use the key to get it delivered there.
apiKeys.confirmDeleteDescription: Imagery using this key stops loading tiles until another key is set.
